title: PersonalEvent
description: A private, account-owned system notification about an audience circle. The content lives in a canonical message (message.schema.json, author_account_id NULL) inside the recipient's single account_event conversation. The top level describes the typed routing envelope in PostgreSQL (domain_personal_event_messages). Events are written by database triggers on membership transitions, in the same transaction, never by an HTTP 2xx alone.

message_id.description: Primary key and reference to the canonical message.

circle_id.description: NULL after the circle row is deleted. Historic mail stays.

event_kind.description: circle_invited: to the invitee. circle_invitation_sent: to the inviter. circle_joined, circle_left: to every other active member. circle_declined: to the inviter. circle_withdrawn: to the former invitee.

subject_account_id.description: The other account the event is about (inviter for circle_invited and circle_withdrawn, invitee for circle_invitation_sent and circle_declined, the joining or leaving member otherwise). NULL if that account no longer exists. Never part of an HTTP response.

invitation_created_at.description: Binds an invitation event to the exact membership row revision, so old mail stays inert after a re-invitation. Set exactly for circle_invited and circle_invitation_sent.

read_at.description: Set by POST /api/personal-events/{id}/read. circle_invitation_sent is created already read.

event.description: Item of GET /api/personal-events, visible only to the inbox owner. circle_id and circle_name are present only while the reader still has a membership row (invited or active) in a circle that is not inactive; a former member keeps a neutral notice without circle identity. No other member's account id is exposed, except target_account_id for the inviter's own still-pending invitation.

content.description: Fixed neutral German notice text; it never names the circle or another person.

target_account_id.description: Only on circle_invitation_sent, only while that exact invitation is still pending and the reader is still an active member: the invitee, so the inviter can withdraw it.

invitation_created_at.description: Copied from the envelope; set exactly for circle_invited and circle_invitation_sent, also after the invitation is no longer actionable.

actionable.description: True only while the exact invitation revision is still pending in a circle that is not inactive: for the invitee on circle_invited (accept or decline), for the active inviter on circle_invitation_sent (withdraw).

event_page.description: GET /api/personal-events: newest first by (created_at, id), at most 50 items. The next page is requested with before=<id of the last item>. unread_count covers the whole inbox, not only this page.
